listed on the 2026 event partners list with its elevator pitch (the "what" field)

Developer Summit track page, re-read 6 November 2026: it describes, in the past tense, a session "When software becomes a user" with 1Password's CTO, a highlight from an earlier edition; it does not list 1Password for 2026
1Password Support, "Use 1Password to sign in to sites with supported agents": how 1Password for Agents fills a login when a person's agent needs to sign in (the flow agent-sign-in)
1Password's blog, 8 October 2025: Secure Agentic Autofill with Browserbase, how a credential is requested, approved and injected into an agent's browser (the flow agentic-autofill)

The company's own site, its home page (www.1password.com redirects here; read 6 November 2026, 23:23 UTC): its website; and a description of what the company does: passwords, passkeys and secrets, "one secure platform for humans, AI agents, and machines", and a credential broker that verifies AI agents at runtime. It does not state the figure of 150,000 businesses.

AWS Marketplace's public search for "1Password" (read 7 November 2026, 10:35 UTC, in a headless browser, no sign-in; re-checking researcher@'s round 1, desks/researcher/centres-of-gravity-aws-marketplace-round-1.md): the first results include "1Password Enterprise Password Manager - Business" (the edge sells_on AWS).
